title: NEW KEYS: E SEARCH, X EXTRACT, Q CROWBAR
why: His orders of 2026-10-13: switch some keys around. E is search, always: boxes, bodies and caches, in an extraction ring too, and it never calls an extraction any more. X is the extraction: in a ring it starts the call, and in a landed ring it boards (every ring prompt, the banner words, the downed screen and the controls lists now say X). G is the quick throw of whatever throwable is selected, with no need to find it on the belt. H is the quick heal: it uses the best heal you carry without opening the backpack, with the same rules as the belt (a Bandage heals to 85, a Medkit to 100). Q is the melee, now a crowbar: the same blow, reach and cooldown as before, drawn as a short steel crowbar swinging through the arc with a trail, a metal whoosh as it swings and a thud where it lands. F brings up the next gun on keys 1 to 4, skipping an empty key and wrapping round. The controls list moves to F1 (it was H) and switching throwable moves to U (it was Q). X used to search on the way out, which E does everywhere now. The controller layout is unchanged.
now: E searches, X calls and boards the extraction, G throws, H heals, Q swings a crowbar, F brings up the next gun, F1 shows the controls.
